title: Blocklist
description: Email addresses and domains that cannot join this organization. A domain also blocks its subdomains. Current members are never removed: end their memberships above if you need to.
blocked: You cannot join this organization. Ask one of its administrators.
valueHelp: For example name@example.com, or example.com to block the whole domain.
removeBody: People at this address or domain can be invited and join again.
matching: {count, plural, =0 {No current member matches} one {# current member matches} other {# current members match}}
added: Added. Revoked {invites, plural, one {# invitation} other {# invitations}} and declined {requests, plural, one {# request} other {# requests}} to join.

errors.blocklist_value_invalid: Enter an email address such as name@example.com, or a domain such as example.com.
errors.blocklist_own_domain: This domain is, or contains, one of the organization's verified domains. Block single addresses there instead.
errors.blocklist_duplicate: This address or domain is already on the blocklist.
errors.blocklist_full: A blocklist holds at most 1,000 entries. Remove some, or block a domain instead of its addresses.
errors.org_read_only: This organization is read-only, so the blocklist cannot change now.
errors.denied: You need permission to manage members to change the blocklist.
errors.unexpected: Something went wrong on our side. Try again in a moment.
